title: ROOF PANEL STOWAGE
summary: Coupe (19437) roof panel stowage: the strap that holds the removable roof panels (T-tops) on the rear deck luggage rack area when stored. The strap assembly runs between two hangers, one at each end; each hanger sits on spacers over holes in the rear deck and is screwed down.

parts.name: STRAP ASM.-CHART
parts.name_expanded: Strap assembly – roof panel (T-top) stowage strap (see chart)

fastening.to: rear deck, through the marked holes
fastening.qty: 2 hangers (one at each end of the strap)
fastening.note: Each hanger [2] sits on two spacers [1] placed over two holes in the deck; screw [3] goes down through the hanger and spacer into the hole. One screw is drawn per hanger.
The end loops of strap [4] hook over the hangers [2] at the front and rear ends.

notes: HOLES (2 places, marked with a boxed symbol)
